findings.message: Dispatch now calls sender.Send(ctx, message), but the Sender.Send method shown in the hunk context still has signature Send(text string) error and does not accept a context. This will fail to compile (too many arguments / wrong argument type) unless Send is also updated to take ctx and use it for cancellation/timeouts.
findings.suggestion: Update Sender.Send to func (s *Sender) Send(ctx context.Context, text string) error and pass ctx into the HTTP request (e.g. http.NewRequestWithContext), or revert Dispatch to call sender.Send(message) if ctx is not yet supported.
